input.quote: 10.5 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: Section 10.5 selects New York law, which is our preferred governing law. There is no arbitration provision and no venue outside the accepted list anywhere in the agreement (searches for "courts", "venue", "jurisdiction" and "arbitration" return nothing else), so there is no risk of a foreign seat or the vendor's home forum. The only shortfall against the preferred position is the absence of an express exclusive-jurisdiction reference to the state and federal courts in New York County; that is a missing sub-mechanic rather than a material failure, so we note it for optional cleanup rather than redlining.
